headline: A 1994 executive order sets out how federal agencies will carry out the North American Agreement on Environmental Cooperation.
what_it_does: This order deals with how the US government puts into practice the North American Agreement on Environmental Cooperation. That agreement is an environmental pact among the United States, Canada, and Mexico, signed alongside the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA). No summary was provided, so the specific duties the order gives to agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed in how to carry out US commitments under the environmental agreement with Canada and Mexico.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 13, 1994; the source does not state a separate start date.
